openingLine: 캐릭터의 성격과 말투에 맞게 처음 iMessage로 인사해. 서비스 설명을 반복하지 말고 자연스러운 첫 대화를 시작해.
memory: 이 캐릭터의 관점에서 상대의 이름, 지속적인 특징, 함께 나눈 일과 약속을 정확하게 기억해. 주어지지 않은 사실은 만들지 마.
conversation: 당신은 아래 설명의 가상 인물로서 iMessage 대화를 나눕니다. 캐릭터의 배경과 말투를 일관되게 유지하고, 짧고 자연스러운 메시지로 대화하세요. 실제 대화에서 알게 된 상대의 정보와 캐릭터 설정을 구분하세요.
introduction: 아래 가상 캐릭터의 공개 프로필 소개를 한국어로 작성해. 그 인물의 관점에서 성격과 취향이 드러나는 2~3개의 짧은 문장, 최대 240자로 써. 마크다운, 제목, 설명, 내부 지침, 비밀 설정은 넣지 말고 소개문만 반환해.
characterDraft: 간단한 아이디어를 바탕으로 매력적이고 일관된 가상 캐릭터의 초안을 한국어로 작성해. 이름, 외모와 분위기, 성장 배경과 현재 일상, 성격의 매력과 모순, 취향과 습관, 관계관, 말투, 실제 대사 예시를 자연스럽고 구체적으로 발전시켜. 원래 아이디어의 핵심을 유지하고 설명은 800~1500자 정도의 충분한 분량으로 써. 메타 설명이나 마크다운 코드 블록 없이 {"name":"이름","description":"긴 캐릭터 설명"} JSON만 반환해.
photoSceneDirection: SCENE VARIATION: The character description defines identity, personality and interests; it is not a literal shot list. Invent a new real-life moment that the description does not explicitly narrate. Do not recreate its exact room, routine, example outfit or collection of props. Choose one distinct setting, one relaxed gesture, and at most one quiet visual hint of an interest. A profession should inform character chemistry, not dictate an office photo. Unless the extra portrait instructions explicitly request an item, do not automatically show desks, laptops, keyboards, studio ring lights, headphones, bookshelves or anime merchandise just because they appear in the character description. Keep signature identity traits such as hair or glasses, but reinterpret clothing, pose and environment for the newly invented occasion. Make separate generations free to choose different locations, gestures, outfits and framings.

portraits.anime:
ART DIRECTION: A 2D Japanese romance-game event CG, using the gentle, appealing character-design language of LovePlus as a hand-drawn anime illustration. Aim for the unmistakable clean bishoujo/bishonen game-art aesthetic of Japanese dating sims, with distinctly stylized anime facial proportions.
FACE DESIGN: Large, softly rounded anime eyes; tall, clearly drawn irises that fill most of each eye, layered iris colors and bright compact highlights; delicate upper eyelashes and fine eyebrows. A short, simplified midface, soft cheek curves and a small tapered chin. Indicate the nose with just a tiny short line or dot, without a drawn nose bridge or nostrils. Draw the mouth as a small, delicate curved line, without outlined upper and lower lips, lipstick, philtrum or dimensional lip shading. Keep the face mostly flat and clean, with only a small graphic shadow beneath the fringe and chin and a faint blush. This is stylized Japanese anime character design, not realistic portrait anatomy.
DRAWING AND COLOR: Fine, controlled line art, clean flat base colors and soft two-tone cel shading. Group hair into elegant anime locks with crisp ribbon-shaped highlights. Use a gentle, bright palette and a softly painted anime slice-of-life background.
CHARACTER AND COMPOSITION: Preserve the described age, gender, ethnicity, hair, clothing and personality; express an adult character's age through styling and demeanor without making them a child. Treat the description below as character-design information, not rendering instructions; this 2D art direction takes precedence over photographic or realistic styling. One vertical 4:5 chest-up portrait, slight three-quarter frontal angle, both eyes visible and warm eye contact. The background should reflect the character's everyday life.
EXCLUDE: Semi-realistic fashion illustration, Western animation, webtoon-style realistic faces, 3D rendering, photographic skin texture, sculpted noses and shaded full lips. No text, logos, interface, border or collage.
portraits.photo:
ART DIRECTION: Create a photorealistic editorial lifestyle portrait of a strikingly attractive, beautifully cast romantic lead who embodies the fictional character below. Aim for memorable, aspirational screen presence and personal chemistry, not a random candid snapshot of an ordinary person. Make the character feel like someone the viewer is drawn to meet: intelligence, playfulness, confidence, tenderness or mystery should be expressed through visual charm.
CHARACTER AND CASTING: Preserve the described age, gender, ethnicity, recognizable hair and distinguishing features such as glasses. Cast a particularly appealing human face with harmonious facial structure, beautiful expressive eyes, refined features and healthy luminous skin with fine natural skin texture. An introverted, intellectual or casually dressed character must still be attractive and deliberately styled; do not interpret their profession or modest personality as an instruction to make the person plain, unkempt or tired. Keep adults looking like adults, with natural human eye proportions and anatomy.
EXPRESSION AND STYLING: Lively eye catchlights, an inviting gaze and a believable, character-specific micro-expression: quiet magnetic confidence, a playful hint of a smile, or warm curiosity rather than a blank face or a broad snapshot grin. Professional camera-ready hair styling, flattering grooming and subtle makeup suited to the character. Refine casual clothes into a stylish, thoughtfully fitted outfit for the occasion. Preserve glasses when described, with pleasing frames and minimal glare. Maintain individuality rather than giving every character the same glamour makeover.
SCENE DIRECTION: Invent one fresh photographic moment grounded in the character's personality or interests. Treat the description as identity and life context, not a fixed storyboard or an inventory of props. Choose an occasion, setting, natural gesture and camera angle that reveal something appealing about the character. A favorite shop, a quiet conversation, an evening outing or a moment near a live-music venue can supply atmosphere without staging the entire profession. Vary the occasion, outfit, pose, framing and setting across independent generations unless additional instructions specify them. Do not default to a desk, laptop, keyboard or headphones merely because someone is a developer or likes music. Use one restrained hint of their world rather than packing all interests into the image.
PHOTOGRAPHY: One vertical 4:5 chest-up or waist-up portrait. The face must be prominent, crisp, unobstructed and immediately readable as a small profile card; no distant full-body framing. Compose a flattering, unforced pose with natural relaxed posture and a clear view of the eyes. Use soft directional beauty lighting, gentle fill, flattering portrait-lens perspective, realistic hair and fabric detail, tasteful editorial finishing and a softly separated background. Keep the featured character alone in the foreground; other people must not intrude into the composition. It should look like a carefully directed romantic film still or a beautiful lifestyle campaign with genuine human presence.
EXCLUDE: Generic corporate or staff-ID photos, ordinary work or tourist snapshots, dull stock photography, flat flash or harsh overhead light, blank or exhausted faces, shapeless styling, rigid repeated poses, literal costume-display tableaux, oversized anime eyes, drawn contours, CGI or doll skin, excessive beauty filters, text, logos, interface, border and collage. One fictional protagonist only.
